# Seconds the tests of tests/conformance took, summed per module and, for the modules named by a `module::test` line, per test.
# Measured by `RUSTC_BOOTSTRAP=1 cargo test -p cancho --test conformance -- -Zunstable-options --report-time`, macOS arm64, debug, 2026-11-08.
# Only the proportions matter: scripts/conformance_shard.py packs the units (a module, or each test of a split module) into shards by them.
# A module (or a test of a split module) not listed weighs 3. To remeasure, run the command above and regenerate this file.
